title.zh: OG.com cleared by SEC to offer single-stock futures, says Crypto.com CEO
title.en: OG.com cleared by SEC to offer single-stock futures, says Crypto.com CEO

current_state.zh: OG.com, the sister futures exchange of Crypto.com, received SEC acknowledgement of its 1-N filing to list single-stock futures in the US, with plans to work with the CFTC on single-stock perpetuals.
